requirement: The schematic program — unit count, mix, rentable area, parking and amenity — is reconciled line by line to the program that was underwritten.
expected_evidence: Program comparison table, schematic vs underwriting
title: Program reconciled to underwriting
objective: The schematic program — unit count, mix, rentable area, parking and amenity — is reconciled line by line to the program that was underwritten.

requirement: Gross-to-net efficiency achieved in the schematic plan is measured and tested against the ratio assumed in the model.
title: Efficiency ratio tested
objective: Gross-to-net efficiency achieved in the schematic plan is measured and tested against the ratio assumed in the model.

requirement: Every departure from the underwritten program carries a dated owner decision, not a designer assumption.
expected_evidence: Decision log with dates and signatures
title: Program changes have owner decisions
objective: Every departure from the underwritten program carries a dated owner decision, not a designer assumption.

requirement: The schematic yield does not exceed what the entitlement approvals actually permit.
title: Yield conforms to approvals
objective: The schematic yield does not exceed what the entitlement approvals actually permit.

requirement: A schematic-level estimate has been produced by a qualified estimator against the actual schematic documents.
expected_evidence: Schematic estimate with basis and exclusions
title: Schematic estimate produced
objective: A schematic-level estimate has been produced by a qualified estimator against the actual schematic documents.

requirement: The schematic estimate is reconciled to the control budget and every variance is explained by a scope or market cause.
title: Estimate reconciled to budget
objective: The schematic estimate is reconciled to the control budget and every variance is explained by a scope or market cause.

requirement: Where the estimate exceeds budget, a documented design-to-budget decision is made before design development begins.
expected_evidence: Value engineering log; owner decision record
title: Design-to-budget gate held
objective: Where the estimate exceeds budget, a documented design-to-budget decision is made before design development begins.

requirement: Escalation from the estimate date to the anticipated bid date is restated at schematic, not carried from acquisition.
expected_evidence: Escalation assumption with index and dates
title: Escalation to bid restated
objective: Escalation from the estimate date to the anticipated bid date is restated at schematic, not carried from acquisition.

requirement: Every allowance and exclusion in the schematic estimate is listed and carries an owner acknowledgement.
title: Allowances and exclusions listed
objective: Every allowance and exclusion in the schematic estimate is listed and carries an owner acknowledgement.

requirement: The schematic site plan conforms to the approved site plan, or every deviation is identified with its amendment path and duration.
title: Site plan conforms to approval
objective: The schematic site plan conforms to the approved site plan, or every deviation is identified with its amendment path and duration.

requirement: Site development cost at schematic is built from the geotechnical, stormwater and utility findings — not from a per-acre allowance and not from the acquisition placeholder.
expected_evidence: Site cost buildup citing each study
title: Site cost carried from evidence
objective: Site development cost at schematic is built from the geotechnical, stormwater and utility findings — not from a per-acre allowance and not from the acquisition placeholder.

requirement: Electrical, gas, water and sanitary loads for the schematic program are established and reconciled to the confirmed capacity.
title: Utility loads established
objective: Electrical, gas, water and sanitary loads for the schematic program are established and reconciled to the confirmed capacity.

requirement: Building code path, occupancy classification, construction type and egress strategy are established and reviewed by the code consultant.
title: Code and life-safety strategy set
objective: Building code path, occupancy classification, construction type and egress strategy are established and reviewed by the code consultant.

requirement: The accessibility strategy, including any required unit counts and public-accommodation obligations, is established at schematic.
title: Accessibility strategy set
objective: The accessibility strategy, including any required unit counts and public-accommodation obligations, is established at schematic.

requirement: Every discipline required to complete the design is engaged, with scopes that meet at the boundaries and no gap between them.
title: Consultant coverage complete
objective: Every discipline required to complete the design is engaged, with scopes that meet at the boundaries and no gap between them.

requirement: Delegated design scopes are identified now and assigned, so they are not discovered during buyout.
title: Design responsibility assigned
objective: Delegated design scopes are identified now and assigned, so they are not discovered during buyout.

requirement: Owner decisions required to complete design development are calendared against their latest responsible dates.
expected_evidence: Decision register with latest responsible dates
title: Owner decision calendar
objective: Owner decisions required to complete design development are calendared against their latest responsible dates.

requirement: Items whose lead time exceeds the remaining design duration are identified at schematic and their order dates calendared.
expected_evidence: Long-lead register with required order dates
title: Long-lead identified at schematic
objective: Items whose lead time exceeds the remaining design duration are identified at schematic and their order dates calendared.

requirement: The development schedule is rebuilt from the schematic scope and reconciled to the financing milestones.
title: Schedule rebuilt at schematic
objective: The development schedule is rebuilt from the schematic scope and reconciled to the financing milestones.

requirement: The permanent financing or sale strategy is documented with its trigger conditions, target date and fallback.
expected_evidence: Takeout strategy memorandum approved by the sponsor
title: Takeout strategy documented
objective: The permanent financing or sale strategy is documented with its trigger conditions, target date and fallback.

requirement: Construction loan maturity, every extension option and each condition attaching to those options is calendared with owner-level alerts.
title: Construction loan maturity calendared
objective: Construction loan maturity, every extension option and each condition attaching to those options is calendared with owner-level alerts.

requirement: Every numeric extension condition — occupancy, closings, debt service coverage, completion — is tested against the current forecast, not against the plan.
expected_evidence: Condition test worksheet against current forecast
title: Extension conditions tested against forecast
objective: Every numeric extension condition — occupancy, closings, debt service coverage, completion — is tested against the current forecast, not against the plan.

requirement: Indicative terms have been obtained from more than one source and tested against the model.
expected_evidence: Term sheets or indications; comparison analysis
title: Takeout market tested
objective: Indicative terms have been obtained from more than one source and tested against the model.

requirement: The full lead time from application to funding is established from the lender, and back-solved against maturity.
expected_evidence: Lender process schedule; back-solved milestone dates
title: Lead time to close established
objective: The full lead time from application to funding is established from the lender, and back-solved against maturity.

requirement: The lender diligence checklist has been received and every item assigned to a named seat with a date.
title: Diligence checklist received and owned
objective: The lender diligence checklist has been received and every item assigned to a named seat with a date.

requirement: Operating statements, rent roll, TI and leasing commission history and capital expenditure records are assembled to the lender's required period.
title: Historical operating data assembled
objective: Operating statements, rent roll, TI and leasing commission history and capital expenditure records are assembled to the lender's required period.

requirement: Final construction cost is reconciled to the budget, to draws funded and to lien waivers, with every variance explained.
title: Construction cost record reconciled
objective: Final construction cost is reconciled to the budget, to draws funded and to lien waivers, with every variance explained.

requirement: Certificates of occupancy, agency sign-offs, commissioning reports and the punch closeout record are assembled for the lender.
expected_evidence: Completion package index with each certificate
title: Completion evidence assembled
objective: Certificates of occupancy, agency sign-offs, commissioning reports and the punch closeout record are assembled for the lender.

requirement: Every open claim, lien, dispute and threatened action is identified and its disclosure position agreed with counsel.
title: Open claims and litigation disclosed
objective: Every open claim, lien, dispute and threatened action is identified and its disclosure position agreed with counsel.

requirement: The appraisal scope, comparable set and stabilised assumptions are reviewed before the report is issued, not after.
title: Appraisal scope and assumptions reviewed
objective: The appraisal scope, comparable set and stabilised assumptions are reviewed before the report is issued, not after.

requirement: Appraised value supports the loan-to-value and debt-yield tests at the required proceeds, with headroom stated.
title: Valuation supports proceeds
objective: Appraised value supports the loan-to-value and debt-yield tests at the required proceeds, with headroom stated.

requirement: Occupancy, rent roll and absorption evidence supporting the stabilised assumption is current and independently verifiable.
expected_evidence: Certified rent roll; executed leases or closings
title: Stabilisation evidence current
objective: Occupancy, rent roll and absorption evidence supporting the stabilised assumption is current and independently verifiable.

requirement: Title has been updated to date-down and every lender-required endorsement is confirmed obtainable.
title: Title updated and endorsements obtained
objective: Title has been updated to date-down and every lender-required endorsement is confirmed obtainable.

requirement: Mechanics lien exposure is cleared by final waivers, releases or bonded discharge, and the lien period has run.
expected_evidence: Final lien waivers; release record; lien search
title: Mechanics lien exposure cleared
objective: Mechanics lien exposure is cleared by final waivers, releases or bonded discharge, and the lien period has run.

requirement: An as-built survey reflecting the completed improvements and all recorded easements has been delivered and accepted.
title: As-built survey delivered
objective: An as-built survey reflecting the completed improvements and all recorded easements has been delivered and accepted.

requirement: Tenant estoppels and subordination agreements required by the lender are obtained within their validity window.
title: Estoppels and SNDAs obtained
objective: Tenant estoppels and subordination agreements required by the lender are obtained within their validity window.

requirement: Every covenant in the takeout commitment — coverage, occupancy, reserves, reporting — is tested and demonstrated before closing.
title: Covenant compliance demonstrated
objective: Every covenant in the takeout commitment — coverage, occupancy, reserves, reporting — is tested and demonstrated before closing.

requirement: Required reserves — TI, leasing commission, capital, debt service, replacement — are quantified and the funding source identified.
title: Reserve requirements funded
objective: Required reserves — TI, leasing commission, capital, debt service, replacement — are quantified and the funding source identified.

requirement: Reporting obligations surviving into the permanent loan are extracted into a calendar with named owners.
title: Ongoing reporting obligations understood
objective: Reporting obligations surviving into the permanent loan are extracted into a calendar with named owners.

requirement: Completion, carry and repayment guaranty burn-off conditions are tracked against evidence, and release is pursued when earned.
title: Guaranty burn-off conditions tracked
objective: Completion, carry and repayment guaranty burn-off conditions are tracked against evidence, and release is pursued when earned.

requirement: The recourse position under the permanent loan is compared to the construction loan and the change is accepted in writing.
title: Recourse position at takeout understood
objective: The recourse position under the permanent loan is compared to the construction loan and the change is accepted in writing.

requirement: Interest rate exposure between application and funding is identified and a lock, cap or hedge decision is made and dated.
expected_evidence: Rate exposure analysis; lock or hedge confirmation
title: Rate exposure managed
objective: Interest rate exposure between application and funding is identified and a lock, cap or hedge decision is made and dated.

requirement: Rate lock expiry is aligned to the realistic closing date, with extension cost quantified.
title: Lock expiry aligned to closing
objective: Rate lock expiry is aligned to the realistic closing date, with extension cost quantified.

requirement: The construction loan payoff, including accrued interest, exit fee and any prepayment charge, is calculated and verified with the lender.
title: Payoff calculated and verified
objective: The construction loan payoff, including accrued interest, exit fee and any prepayment charge, is calculated and verified with the lender.

requirement: Closing sources and uses balance, including all costs, reserves, prorations and any equity return.
title: Sources and uses at closing balance
objective: Closing sources and uses balance, including all costs, reserves, prorations and any equity return.

requirement: Any distribution at takeout is calculated under the operating agreement waterfall and agreed with the equity partner before funding.
title: Equity distribution waterfall applied
objective: Any distribution at takeout is calculated under the operating agreement waterfall and agreed with the equity partner before funding.

requirement: Discharge of the construction mortgage and all related instruments is recorded, and the record confirmed.
title: Construction loan discharged of record
objective: Discharge of the construction mortgage and all related instruments is recorded, and the record confirmed.
